args.description: 读取 object-tracking skill 的 SKILL.md 文件
执行 object-tracking skill 的测试命令，创建目录、生成 detections.json 并运行 tracking 脚本
args.command:
mkdir -p /mnt/user-data/outputs/object-tracking /mnt/user-data/workspace/object-tracking
python - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
detections = {"detections":[
  {"frame_id":"frame_001","timestamp":"2026-05-20T10:00:00+08:00","objects":[{"object_id":"det_001","label":"person","confidence":0.91,"bbox":[100,100,180,260]}]},
  {"frame_id":"frame_002","timestamp":"2026-05-20T10:00:02+08:00","objects":[{"object_id":"det_002","label":"person","confidence":0.89,"bbox":[120,105,200,265]}]}
]}
p = pathlib.Path('/mnt/user-data/workspace/object-tracking/detections.json')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
json.dump(detections, p.open('w'), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
PY
python /mnt/skills/custom/object-tracking/scripts/run.py --detections-json /mnt/user-data/workspace/object-tracking/detections.json --camera-id CAM_DEERFLOW_001 --config /mnt/skills/custom/configs/deerflow_config.json --output /mnt/user-data/outputs/object-tracking/result.json
